summary_en: This study tests MK-2010 given together with sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT) in people with advanced solid tumors. Both drugs are given as an intravenous (IV) infusion, and how long or how often they are given is not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, and how many participants have their cancer respond to treatment; it is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa MK-2010 administrado junto con sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT) en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV); la duración y la frecuencia no se indican en el registro. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y cuántos participantes tienen una respuesta del cáncer al tratamiento; es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1
If HIV-infected, HIV is well controlled on antiretroviral therapy
If hepatitis B surface antigen positive, undetectable HBV viral load and at least 4 weeks of HBV antiviral therapy
If history of hepatitis C infection, undetectable HCV viral load
not_for: Prior systemic anticancer therapy within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives before allocation
Active or known central nervous system metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Noninfectious pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease requiring steroids, current pneumonitis, or suspected ILD
Active or ongoing stomatitis or mucositis of any grade
